keyword: concrete pump 40 low pressure or diesel

title.en: Searching “40”: Three Xingtai Pages, Not One Pump
title.zh: 搜索“40”：邢台有三张页，不是一台泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40. Motors are 45 kW, 37 kW and a 4108 / 66 kW diesel. Outputs are 21, 12–15 and 26 m³/h.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台列出电动40、电动低压40和柴油40。动力是 45 kW、37 kW 和 4108 / 66 kW 柴油。输送量是 21、12–15 和 26 m³/h。

h1.en: The Number 40 Splits into Three Orders
h1.zh: 数字 40 拆成三张订单

directAnswer.en: A buyer who types only “40” still has to pick a page at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 40 is 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, with fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and one fine-stone pair, 80 m / 240 m. Diesel 40 is 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and 120 m / 360 m. Name one path on the contact page. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 只输入“40”的买家，仍要在河北品锦机械（邢台）选定一页。电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa，细石 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料 40 m / 120 m。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa，只有一组细石 80 m / 240 m。柴油40是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、120 m / 360 m。在询盘页点明一条路径。没有印价格。

body.en: Electric Low Pressure 40 prints 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg, the same frame numbers as Electric 30, not as Electric 40. Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 2300 kg. Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg.

heading.en: Low pressure is a page name

body.en: “Low pressure” on this catalogue is the name of Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric Low Pressure 60. It is not a mode switch written onto Electric 40. Electric 40’s pressure cell is 23 MPa. The low-pressure 40 page’s pressure cell is 20 MPa.
body.zh: 这份目录里的“低压”是电动低压40和电动低压60的页名。它不是写在电动40上的挡位。电动40的压力格是 23 MPa。低压40页的压力格是 20 MPa。

heading.zh: 询盘必须分开写的内容

body.en: Write the slug, the kilowatts, and which distance row you mean. Diesel 40’s page description ties 120 m / 360 m to 1 cm aggregate, and that sheet does not add a separate maximum-aggregate cell in the specification list used here. Send your stone size to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 写上型号地址、千瓦，以及你指的距离行。柴油40的页面说明把 120 m / 360 m 与 1 cm 骨料写在一起，而此处使用的规格列表没有另加最大骨料格。请把石子粒径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is Electric Low Pressure 40 a setting on Electric 40?
question.zh: 电动低压40是电动40上的一个挡位吗？

answer.en: No. It is a separate Xingtai page with 37 kW and 12–15 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。它是邢台的另一页，37 kW、12–15 m³/h。

answer.en: Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40 each print Kawasaki 112 on their own sheets. Quote the page, not the pump name alone.
answer.zh: 电动40、电动低压40和柴油40各自的表上都印了川崎 112。要写页面，不要只写泵的名字。

answer.en: Unprinted. Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms it per path.
answer.zh: 没有印。河北品锦机械按路径确认。
